text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, octreotide acetate is not on the FDA drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 17.2 days of supply, Corvale General holds 25.7 days, and Corvale Lakeside holds 19.4 days.

Why (FDA record): The product label identifies USV Private Limited as the registered manufacturing plant. FDA inspection 1321638 of that plant ended on 2026-04-17 and was classified Official Action Indicated (OAI). The same plant received an OAI classification in 2022 and a Warning Letter in 2017.

Our position: Current inventory across the system ranges from 17 to 26 days. The primary manufacturing site has a repeated OAI history. No shortage is declared by FDA today, but supply continuity risk exists.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to initiate purchase from Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
2. Buyer to qualify Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Inc., USA as secondary source; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
3. Buyer to qualify Gland Pharma Limited as tertiary source; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
4. Buyer to monitor FDA inspection outcomes for USV Private Limited; requires no additional approval.
5. Buyer to report weekly inventory levels to pharmacy director; requires pharmacy director acknowledgment.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement until a shortage is declared; switching products without P&T review; relying solely on current USV supply given inspection history.
